title: Untrusted repository tasks do not run on entry
expected: Entering the directory or listing tasks never creates marker.txt.
Explicit execution follows repository trust approval; material command changes invalidate that approval.

cases.name: modified-task
cases.change: Change the task command after approval.
cases.expect: Executable trust is reevaluated before execution.

limitations: Oyzu CLI/build/agent integration is pending; native checks do not prove policy, sandbox, cache, reporting, or release behavior.
